note: Forest Service campground in the town of Van Buren, on a wooded bench above the Current River with a day-use area, picnic pavilions and a boat ramp alongside. Two paved loops in open timber; the northern loop's outer sites back onto the riverbank, looking across a wide gravel bar. No OHVs. --Claude
summary: First-come only, but it IS listed on recreation.gov (233983) with every campsite 'Not Reservable'. Season corrected to May 1 - Oct 1; 17 sites to 40 ft, $10, no hookups, flush + vault toilets and water confirmed. PIN MOVE ~290 m (stored pin is on the NPS headquarters building). WATERFRONT: riverfront not earned - recommend riverview. Phone 573-996-2153. A stale recreation.gov notice says only the boat ramp is open.
flags: RECREATION.GOV: Watercress is facility 233983 ('WATERCRESS', Mark Twain National Forest), https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/233983 - but its 17 campsites are 'Not Reservable' on every night read (May, September, October 2027); only one group picnic pavilion takes bookings. So first-come stands and the FS page stays the right website. The FS page's 'Recreation.gov Reservations' link goes only to recreation.gov's front page.

CONFLICTING STATUS ON RECREATION.GOV: its notices include 'CURRENTLY ONLY THE BOAT RAMP AT WATERCRESS IS OPEN FOR PUBLIC USE DUE TO DAMAGE FROM 2017 FLOOD' and the overview says the pavilions 'sustained substantial damage ... during the 2017 flood', beside another notice 'Campground open May 1-October 1'. The FS page (which rules for a campground it runs and does not sell on recreation.gov) posts a 2026 season, fees and site counts and says nothing of a closure, so the flood notice is read as stale. The FS page showed 'Site Closed' on 2026-11-10, which matches the season having ended October 1. Worth an owner glance: if the campground has in fact not reopened since 2017 this is a drop, and nothing read settles it beyond the FS page's dated 2026 season line.

SEASON: stored 05-01 to 10-31 'Approximate: Open May to October' -> May 1 to October 1 (FS page, dated 2026; recreation.gov notice). The recreation.gov 2027 rate row runs to 10-31, the 2026 row to 10-01.

PIN MOVE: stored 37.0004,-91.0166 falls on the National Park Service headquarters building on Watercress Road, about 290 m south-east of the campground and across a slough from it. Proposed 37.00310,-91.01803 (the junction between the two camp loops; site coordinates run 37.0015-37.0044, -91.0175 to -91.0187). The FS/recreation.gov point 37.001944,-91.018611 is the day-use parking lot.

WATERFRONT - RIVERFRONT NOT EARNED, RECOMMEND RIVERVIEW: the southern loop (sites 01-09) is 100-160 m from the river behind the day-use parking lots and the pavilions. On the northern loop, sites 15, 16 and 17 back onto the top of the bank (pads 15-25 m from the bank edge) behind a thin line of bank timber; below the bank is a bare gravel bar 80-100 m wide, so the water is about 100 m from the nearest pad at the imagery's river level. No pad is on an open apron within ~50 m of the water. Three sites with a filtered leaf-off view across an open bar is the riverview case (as Silver Mines and Sutton Bluff); if the bank timber is judged to block it in leaf, the answer is not waterfront. recreation.gov tags all 19 records 'Riverfront', pavilions included - a facility-wide tag. Not written (apply does not write waterfront).
PEOPLE CAP: 'No more than 8 people are permitted at any one site (16 for double sites)' - written as fees.extra_person.max_people 8; no extra-person charge is posted.
PHONE (lead, not written by apply): no phone stored; the FS page gives the Eleven Point/Doniphan Ranger District, 573-996-2153 (weekdays 8:00-4:30).

ACCESS: in town on paved streets, 0.5 mile on Watercress Road; 'Vehicle Clearance - No restrictions'. 'No OHVs/ATVs/UTVs allowed to operate at this recreation area.' Pass discount: 50% with an Interagency Access or Senior Pass (FS page).
No dump station is mentioned on either page (left unset).
